scientific_limits: Exploratory already-viewed images; no preregistered discovery or new model.
Correspondences are SIFT hypotheses, not independently verified physical matches.
H is a descriptive fit, not a camera pose estimate, scene-planarity proof, or camera-obedience measure.
Inlier residual is measured on the same data used to select/fit the consensus; low residual is not heldout accuracy.
Three-pixel RANSAC setting is not a guarantee that every refined inlier residual is below three pixels.
Normalized spans use 575-pixel coordinate extent, not object/area coverage.
No warped MSE, pixel correction, threshold tuning or replacement of S70 score.
External60-second timeout belongs to root; forced termination may leave no inner receipt and must be represented by external evidence.
future_independent_result_scope: Saved coordinate/ID/count/mask/H JSON only: independently recompute quantiles, signed dx/dy, spans, H projection and inlier residuals for all12 pairs; no SIFT extraction or homography refit, no correspondence-truth claim.
